entries.title: Pet sprites are back
entries.notes:
- **Pets**: fixed the pet icons that showed up empty across the Manager, Team Builder, feeding lists, logs and alerts
- **Sprites**: pet and egg icons now come straight from the API data, so they no longer depend on name matching to be found

entries.title: Editor rotation and keybind fixes
entries.notes:
- **Editor**: decor rotation is now a slider with a live preview, and each decor only offers the angles it actually supports
- **Keybinds**: attempted fix for the shortcuts that reassigned themselves on their own, and for the pet team shortcuts that kept disappearing

entries.title: Pet team sync is now optional
entries.notes: - **Pets**: a new toggle in the Manager tab lets you unsync the mod's pet teams from the in-game ones. It stays on by default, so nothing changes unless you turn it off

entries.title: Team Builder improvements
entries.notes:
- **Pets**: the Team Builder now shows extra stats for each suggested team
- **Pets**: it also got smarter at putting teams together

entries.title: Tools rework, editor rework, Pet Team Builder
entries.notes:
- **Community Tools**: the whole menu got reworked, list and detail views included, and the tools listed inside were reviewed and updated
- **Editor**: reworked as well, placing decor now follows your mouse directly instead of snapping to a grid
- **Pets**: new Team Builder tab
